svg.aria-label: What is cloud computing. In the centre, a shared resource pool of servers, storage, and networks, reached on demand over the network. Around it, the four deployment models use the pool: a public cloud for many customers who sign up, such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud; a private cloud for one organization, in its own or a hosted data center, used by no other customer; a community cloud for a group of organizations with the same needs, such as government agencies or banks; and a hybrid cloud of two or more models connected, for example a private and a public cloud with a private network link. A note adds that multi-cloud means more than one public cloud.
svg.title: What is cloud computing: a shared resource pool and the four deployment models
svg.text: Shared resources, on demand, over the network
